tvShow.name: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
tvShow.originalName: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
tvShow.overview: After accidentally creating a new multiverse, comic book store owner Stuart Bloom must locate a quantum-interference device to restore reality.

episodes.name: Spoiler: Gary Dies
episodes.overview: After breaking a quantum-interference device, mild-mannered comic book store owner Stuart Bloom must save the universe from imminent destruction.

episodes.name: Spoiler: Zack's in This One
episodes.overview: Stuart, Bert, Denise, and Barry Kripke find themselves in an idyllic, peaceful Earth...that happens to be controlled by a repressive and vicious AI.

episodes.name: Spoiler: Bert Is Magic
episodes.overview: In a world where magic is real, Bert discovers a gift for sorcery, while Stuart enlists the help of one of this universe’s most powerful wizards.

episodes.name: Spoiler: Stuart Makes a Wallet
episodes.overview: Stuart questions what's real after landing in a mental hospital. Kripke finds himself with a new love interest.

episodes.name: Spoiler: Bert Gets Married
episodes.overview: The gang arrives in paradise, where everyone lives in harmony with nature and each other. Bert finds true love and the machine is broken.

episodes.name: Spoiler: Corn Is Delicious
episodes.overview: As Bert and Kripke team up, Stuart and Denise take a big step forward in a universe that looks and feels normal...with one major difference.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Comic book store owner Stuart Bloom is tasked with restoring reality after he breaks a device built by Sheldon and Leonard, accidentally bringing about a multiverse Armageddon. Stuart is aided in this quest by his girlfriend Denise, geologist friend Bert, and quantum physicist/all-around pain in the ass Barry Kripke.

credits.name: John Ross Bowie
credits.character: Barry Kripke / Supreme Ruler Barry Kripke
